blocks.text: When signing in to the Zscaler ITDR Admin Portal for the first time, you must configure two-factor authentication (2FA) using an authenticator app. This adds an extra level of security because you are required to enter both your password and a 2FA code while signing in to the portal.
When you have a new device and you want to configure 2FA on it, you can reset the code.

blocks.item: On the Accounts Settings page, under Two-Factor Authentication, click Reset 2FA.
Enter your Password and the Current 2FA code that appears on the authenticator app.
When a QR code appears, scan it using an authenticator app.
Enter the one-time password (OTP). This is the 6-digit code shown on the authenticator app.
